reasons: Datadog sums nginx.net.reading across all series (sum with no by-clause), but the candidate wraps the selector in avg(), which computes a different aggregate whenever more than one series matches.
The metric choice is reasonable: nginx.connections_current with state="reading" measures the same quantity, and the state label is observed in the dataset.
The $scope template variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct and the series set matches.
Outcome translated is correct because an exact translation exists; the fix is to use sum() instead of avg().
